title: Is Your Body Running Loud?
caption: Wired and worn out? You might feel bursts of restlessness and then sudden tiredness, with focus that snaps in short bits. Take short breaks, favor quick gentle movement over long workouts, and pace big tasks so you finish what matters.
snapshot: Space weather has been active with recent flares and some ejections. The geomagnetic background is lively and resonance readings are a bit higher than usual. Expect a bit more nervous-system chatter than on calmer days.
affects: You may notice bursts of restlessness followed by sudden fatigue. Focus stretches could feel shorter and more fractured. For some, muscles or joints read louder during these swings.
playbook:
- Pause for 3–5 minutes every hour to breathe or stretch
- Favor short, easy movement over long workouts
- Keep caffeine lighter late in the day
- Hydrate and add a pinch of electrolytes if you feel shaky

fb.caption: Body buzzing for no clear reason? You might be feeling that jittery mix where you’re wired and tired at once — like an over-caffeinated squirrel that can’t pick a tree. Space weather has been lively, with active geomagnetics, a few recent flares and CMEs, and a slightly elevated background hum. That combination tends to shorten clean focus stretches and leaves some people feeling restless or overly alert in the evening. Pace the day with short resets and softer evening light so your body can lean out of the buzz before bedtime. If you’re sensitive, keep activity lighter and tuck in a five- to ten-minute reset before evening tasks. Stay curious about how your body answers; Gaia Eyes is watching the sky and offering gentle cues.
